verdict.rationale: Lighthouse's own site has a self-serve EB-1A qualifier prompt ('Answer a few questions about your profile and see where you stand'), and a similar one for E-2. That shows a structured self-assessment for EB-1, but the evidence is a single call-to-action line on a blog page: it doesn't say the tool is free, describe what it outputs, or show an O-1 version. The 'Candidate Eligibility Evaluation' on the pricing page is a plan-included service, not a self-serve tool, so it isn't credited. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation the check is free, an O-1 qualifier, documentation of the tool's structure and results, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a free structured eligibility check — a self-serve O-1/EB-1 qualifier or assessment tool on the provider's site
